findings.statement: Sorting the key index across threads speeds up the sort
findings.detail: sort 0.0229s parallel against 0.0362s sequential (sequential vs parallel: greater 1.578x (p=0.0051, rel_iqr 13.5%/27.2%))

findings.statement: That speed-up is visible in the load it is part of
findings.detail: 953658 ops/s parallel against 894844 sequential (parallel vs sequential: NO DIFFERENCE (ratio 1.066, p=0.2963) -- within noise, not a result). f31 put the ceiling at 7% for the sort alone before this was written, which is the point of measuring it: a change whose best case is single digits has to clear the noise of the thing it is embedded in, and that is a different question from whether the sort got faster

notes: both arms interleaved; the only difference is Options::parallel_index
